documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015- ESG Rating

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with standalone and consolidated revenue growth, accompanied by stable operating margins despite volatility in raw materials and logistics costs. Management highlighted continued volume growth from overseas markets, particularly US automotive OEM orders, while domestic footwear demand remained muted. The company is expanding existing capacity by adding a new line expected to start production by early 2027 and continues to evaluate potential international greenfield or brownfield expansion options. In Q3 FY26, Mayur Uniquoters achieved standalone revenue from operations of INR 236.99 crores and consolidated revenue of INR 237.48 crores. Management expects revenue growth to average around 15% over the coming years, supported by strong performance in export markets.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the present quarter's margin is sustainable and expected to continue.
guidance.quote: But this present quarter's margin will be sustainable and expected to continue.

guidance.claim: Management expects US business to increase by 60% to 70% in the next three years.
guidance.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right? In terms of US automotive.

guidance.claim: Mayur Uniquoters is targeting 15% growth in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand in the domestic footwear segment was muted due to a sharp increase in sole and raw material prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the recent FTA signed by India is a very positive move that will improve cost effectiveness and customer procurement sentiments from India.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase.

demand_outlook.claim: The positive growth momentum in exports is expected to continue for the next two to three years.
demand_outlook.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's domestic footwear business is not growing due to local competition and low margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has ordered a new line for its current premises with production expected to start towards the end of the financial year between February and March 2027, adding an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that if they decide to put up a new facility, the capex in the next 2 years would be INR250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores. Yes, it will be additional.

capex_expansion.claim: It will take approximately two years for the proposed plant to start after a final decision is made.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

capex_expansion.claim: Mayur Uniquoters has established a new company in Europe to expand its export business.
capex_expansion.quote: So we have now formed a new company in Europe, and we are exporting from India to Europe, getting stock over there and tackle customers over there also.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the previous quarter's margin was abnormally high due to an abnormal increase in foreign exchange rates.
margins_costs.quote: But last quarter, it was abnormally high because of foreign exchange increase in -- abnormally high increase in foreign exchange rates. So that was a onetime increase basically.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that shipping costs for exports increased 4x during the quarter due to the Gulf War situation.
margins_costs.quote: It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that raw material prices went up sharply, followed by a fall and subsequent increases, creating a volatile situation.
margins_costs.quote: The prices went up very sharply, then there was a fall in prices of some raw materials. Then again, the prices went up again. So, it's been a very volatile situation.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects to maintain EBITDA margins around 24% to 25% level due to higher export growth.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, we should be able to maintain this level of margin.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material imports account for nearly one-third of total raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of plasticizers and yarn have started increasing.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization is reported to be between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management received good OEM supply orders from the U.S.A., which have started contributing to export sales revenue and profitability.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume achieved in Q3 FY26 was 76.3 lakh meters, including 2.56 lakh meters of PU.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has received export orders from the US for OEM supply.
orders_capacity.quote: And in addition to this, we have already received some good export orders from US for OEM supply and resulting into good contribution to our top line and bottom line.

capital_allocation.claim: Management has not taken any final decision regarding a share buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: So for buyback, we have not taken the call.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited market volatility and geopolitical issues like the West Asia war and Trump tariffs as reasons delaying the final location decision for an international plant.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: The PU segment faces headwinds from cheap imports from China.
risks_headwinds.quote: A lot of cheap imports are coming from China.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to make the company a preferred supplier for leading OEMs in overseas markets, especially the U.S. and European regions.
management_commitments.quote: Further, our endeavor is to make the company as a preferred supplier for the leading OEMs in overseas market, especially the U.S. and European regions.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects sales growth and increased momentum to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to scale up regular plantation activities in coming years under CSR programs.
management_commitments.quote: Under the corporate social responsibility programs, we have contributed towards regular plantations around 50,000 plants already done and have a plan to do it at larger scale in coming years.

management_commitments.claim: Mayur Uniquoters targets a potential outlook of 15% growth in the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

management_commitments.claim: Increased export momentum from US OEM supplies is expected to continue for two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
